product_one_liner.value: Fundraise Up is an online donation platform that helps nonprofits increase fundraising revenue through AI-optimized donor experiences, payment options, and analytics.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 350+ team members worldwide; its funding profile reports 395 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog covers fundraising, product updates, and industry knowledge; no qualifying engineering blog was found.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes campaign setup and multiple platform-specific integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current expanded careers board lists no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science titles. Head Of Data and Revenue Analytics Manager do not meet the specified title criteria.

model_provider.notes: Anthropic is listed as a subprocessor supporting Agentic Giving and platform features. An engineering job description explicitly names OpenAI APIs and OpenAI in its model stack.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims include SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, and PCI DSS Level 1. GDPR is listed as a compliance claim, rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile dates the Series B to December 23, 2024. Fundraise Up publicly announced the $70 million growth capital investment in January 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest known round was announced in January 2025, before the May 2025 start of the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Account Executive, Education Vertical — USA, remote — is listed on the current careers board and has an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: In-Person Giving and DIY Peer-to-Peer were announced live on October 16, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Chris Adams's profile dates his start as VP of Strategic & Enterprise Sales to January 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly documented integration signals, not confirmation that Fundraise Up uses them internally.
